entities.name: A4SSA7
observations: Reviewed Aeromonas salmonicida probable cytosol aminopeptidase; query sequence is an exact 100% match.
M17-family metallopeptidase with two Mn2+ ions per subunit; annotations include EC 3.4.11.1 and 3.4.11.10.
Catalyzes hydrolytic removal of unsubstituted N-terminal amino acids from peptides; leucine is preferred in related reaction annotations.
